projects.title: MultiDoc-RAG
projects.description: • Built a document-intelligence platform that ingests up to 500 PDFs asynchronously via Redis/RQ workers, indexes chunks and embeddings into pgvector-backed PostgreSQL, and returns grounded AI answers with source citations in 4 to 7 seconds• Designed a token-budget reservation system with commit semantics so concurrent multi-document queries don't overshoot daily limits, enabling reliable multi-agent document analysis at scale• Implemented observability endpoints tracking usage, latency, and failures across the full pipeline, making the system debuggable in production rather than a black boxPython • FastAPI • LangGraph • pgvector • PostgreSQL • Redis • RQ • React • Docker • OpenAI API

projects.title: Overleaf MCP Server
projects.description: • Built a production-ready MCP server that connects AI assistants with Overleaf, letting users edit LaTeX files directly from chat without copy-paste or manual formatting fixes• Engineered a section-aware parsing system that detects and updates specific LaTeX sections using regex and structured markers, preserving templates, formatting, and document structure• Serving 300+ website visitors with 20+ real beta users who actively use the tool for resumes, research papers, and academic writing workflows• Implemented full Overleaf Git API integration by cloning the user’s Overleaf project, applying safe edits, committing changes, and pushing updates back to Overleaf in real time• Added read, list, and update MCP tools enabling AI assistants to fetch files, analyze content, replace sections, and keep LaTeX documents synchronized with conversation context• Built a public roadmap with planned productivity features such as section summaries, AI rewriting tools, and multi-file project updates based on community feedbackPython • FastMCP • Git • API Integration • LaTeX • Developer Productivity • AI Integration

projects.title: md2LLM
projects.description: • Built a local-first platform managing the full LLM fine-tuning lifecycle, from Markdown ingestion and dataset generation to hardware-aware training routing and local inference through Ollama.• Implemented note quality scoring via frontmatter parsing and structured JSONL training pair generation, automating the data preparation step that most developers do manually.• Supports 3 training paths (Apple Silicon MLX, NVIDIA Unsloth, Google Colab) with automatic hardware detection, removing the biggest barrier to entry for local LLM fine-tuning.Python • FastAPI • React • Vite • Ollama • Hugging Face • MLX • Unsloth

projects.title: MCP Server for Google Sheets (Python, Google APIs)
projects.description: • Enabled seamless read and write automation using Python and the Google Sheets API improving data operations speed by 40% across multiple spreadsheets.• Delivered reliable batch updates via structured tools handling CSV and list-based inputs to reduce manual edits by 80% for large sheet datasets.• Secured cross-platform connectivity with service-account authentication ensuring 100% credential isolation for all automation workflows.

projects.title: Key-Word Based Retrieval (Collaborated with IBM)

Used government and consumer APIs for data retrieval and Selenium for scraping websites without APIs, enhancing user output.3. Injected scraped data into MySQL and implemented caching and indexing to optimize I/O operations and enhance search results.4. Developed a filtering algorithm to store frequent queries in the database, reducing API calls and improving retrieval efficiency.
